name: Sativus Tech Corp.
summary: Sativus Tech Corp., an agricultural technology enterprise, specializes in the investigation, creation, and commercialization of various products for the farming sector. The company manufactures and distributes automated systems that allow consumers to cultivate their own herbs and vegetables. Moreover, it supplies specialized automated containers tailored for growing saffron. Established in 2015, the firm was previously recognized as Seedo Corp. until it adopted the name Sativus Tech Corp. in December 2021. Its operations are based out of Bethesda, Maryland.
